milestone: 5: second passes the review sent back, and a game that boots clean

tasks.goal: Make a new game boot with no console error and no failed request on the hand map and on seeds 7, 73 and 1234567, so tests/boot-clean.spec.js passes.
tasks.commit: fix(arc): every story board fits its atlas, and a new game boots clean
tasks.notes: Two errors print on every boot today. (A) '[arc] sign lot_arden does not fit the atlas' and the same for lot_trust: src/render/arc.js packs the story signs into a square 1024 px canvas below the 512 px beam cell; the two 3.2 x 3.6 m boards are 403 px tall at SIGN_PX_PER_M = 112 and their row ends at y = 1054, past the canvas, so they sample garbage. Fix it by making the atlas taller, not by shrinking the signs: (1) replace `const ATLAS = 1024;` with `const ATLAS_W = 1024;` and `const ATLAS_H = 2048;` and a one-line comment above them: the story boards stack below the beam, and two of them do not fit under it in a square 1024. (2) In packSigns use ATLAS_W in the row-wrap test and ATLAS_H in the does-not-fit test. (3) In atlasTexture set `c.width = ATLAS_W;` and `c.height = ATLAS_H;`. (4) In the cell-to-UV function (the line `return [x / ATLAS, 1 - (y + h) / ATLAS, w / ATLAS, h / ATLAS];`) divide x and w by ATLAS_W and y and h by ATLAS_H. There must be no `ATLAS` left that is not ATLAS_W or ATLAS_H. (B) A 404: index.html has no icon link, so the browser asks for /favicon.ico. Add `<link rel="icon" href="data:,">` in the head of index.html. If the spec's response listener names a different URL, fix that one instead and say which in your last message. Change nothing else. Draws must not change. tests/arc.spec.js, tests/arc-game.spec.js and tests/gate.spec.js must stay green.

tasks.goal: Add grassFor(district, plan, vistas) to src/render/landscape.js and lay a generated city's grass verges and tufts on the land its streets, building rows, lots and skyline towers leave free, so tests/grass-place.spec.js passes on all 301 seeds.
tasks.commit: fix(landscape): a generated city's grass grows on its own free land, never on a road
tasks.notes: Today buildGrassGround lays five slabs and buildGrassTufts scatters tufts in four rects, all at hand-map coordinates, 5 cm above the road; on every generated city some of that grass lies across a street (826 m2 on seed 73). Edits, all in src/render/landscape.js; main.js does not change. (1) Imports: change the world import to `import { heightAt, DISTRICTS } from '../sim/world.js';` and add `import { WORLD_PLAN, CROSSING_BAND, BUILD_LINE } from '../sim/layout.js';` and `import { WORLD_VISTAS } from '../sim/vistas.js';`. (2) Right below `const GRASS_CELL = 4;` add `export const HAND_GRASS = { slabs: [...], tufts: [...] };` where slabs are today's five slab(...) calls as objects { x, z, w, d } in the same order, keeping each call's comment on its line: { x: -50.75, z: -5, w: 2.5, d: 280 } far-west verge, { x: -32, z: -4, w: 12, d: 284 } west green strip (move the three-line comment about the river bank above it), { x: 61, z: 5, w: 15, d: 32 } pocket park east, { x: 22, z: -71.5, w: 60, d: 4 } connector verge south, { x: 22, z: -56.5, w: 60, d: 4 } connector verge north; and tufts are today's four TUFT_RECTS entries with their comments. Delete the old TUFT_RECTS table. (3) Below HAND_GRASS add, with a comment above grassFor saying it lays verges on the 4 m grass grid over the walk box grown by VERGE_REACH_X and VERGE_REACH_Z, on every cell no street, building row, lot or skyline tower touches, one slab per clear run along z, and tufts inset on every slab: const VERGE_REACH_X = 24; const VERGE_REACH_Z = 8; const TUFT_INSET = 0.5; const rectAt = (x, z, w, d) => ({ x0: x - w / 2, x1: x + w / 2, z0: z - d / 2, z1: z + d / 2 }); const touches = (a, b) => Math.min(a.x1, b.x1) > Math.max(a.x0, b.x0) && Math.min(a.z1, b.z1) > Math.max(a.z0, b.z0); export function grassFor(district, plan, vistas) { const keepOff = [ ...district.avenues.map((a) => rectAt(a.x, (a.z0 + a.z1) / 2, BUILD_LINE * 2, a.z1 - a.z0)), ...district.crossings.map((c) => rectAt((c.x0 + c.x1) / 2, c.z, c.x1 - c.x0, CROSSING_BAND * 2)), ...plan.rows.flatMap((r) => r.runs.map(([z0, z1]) => rectAt(r.ax + r.side * (BUILD_LINE + r.depth / 2), (z0 + z1) / 2, r.depth, z1 - z0))), ...plan.lots.map(([x, z, w, d]) => rectAt(x, z, w, d)), ...[...vistas.caps, ...vistas.ring].map((t) => rectAt(t.x, t.z, t.w, t.d)) ]; const { walk } = district; const zFrom = walk.minZ - VERGE_REACH_Z; const rows = Math.floor((walk.maxZ + VERGE_REACH_Z - zFrom) / GRASS_CELL); const slabs = []; for (let x = walk.minX - VERGE_REACH_X; x + GRASS_CELL <= walk.maxX + VERGE_REACH_X; x += GRASS_CELL) { let from = null; for (let k = 0; k <= rows; k++) { const z = zFrom + k * GRASS_CELL; const clear = k < rows && !keepOff.some((r) => touches({ x0: x, x1: x + GRASS_CELL, z0: z, z1: z + GRASS_CELL }, r)); if (clear && from === null) from = z; if (!clear && from !== null) { slabs.push({ x: x + GRASS_CELL / 2, z: (from + z) / 2, w: GRASS_CELL, d: z - from }); from = null; } } } const tufts = slabs.map((s) => ({ x0: s.x - s.w / 2 + TUFT_INSET, x1: s.x + s.w / 2 - TUFT_INSET, z0: s.z - s.d / 2 + TUFT_INSET, z1: s.z + s.d / 2 - TUFT_INSET })); return { slabs, tufts }; } Give VERGE_REACH_X, VERGE_REACH_Z and TUFT_INSET one-line why comments (grass runs out past the last row so the city's edge is not bare ground; a tuft never hangs over a verge's edge). (4) Then `const GRASS = WORLD_PLAN ? grassFor(DISTRICTS[0], WORLD_PLAN, WORLD_VISTAS) : HAND_GRASS;`. (5) In buildGrassGround replace the five slab(...) lines with `for (const s of GRASS.slabs) slab(s.w, s.d, s.x, s.z);`. (6) In buildGrassTufts replace TUFT_RECTS with GRASS.tufts. Change nothing else. Draws must not change. tests/landscape-place.spec.js, tests/gate.spec.js and tests/chunks.spec.js must stay green.
